items.text: Setup reads your library behind its steps, not in one long wait at the end.
What are you watching right now?: pick your show and episode; seen episodes get no cards.
How would you like to start?: Try it small, Full start or Pre-studied only.
Started small? Ready for more? asks once, when those cards are nearly studied.
Mine only episodes I've pre-studied: Connect waits for the journey's pre-studied mark.
hato's row says ready in hato when its update waits; hato 1.5.0 installs it quietly.
A clearer Soon line: a thin line in Surasura's colours between Current and Soon.
After each new card, your known words are read in 0.18 s instead of 0.84 s.
Removing a deck clears its N waiting; a deck change refreshes the Decks row.
Connect and the card order count the same known words as your list.
Make my new cards again… with Anki closed says Anki isn't open, and deletes nothing.
Still finishing goes away once its work has ended, and the window closes.
Words: 歩き疲れる and 研究棟 are one word each, no longer split.
